The current year period amount is primarily attributable to a gain recognized on the sale of our equity method investment in Australia and on fees received in connection with the transfer of clubs between franchisee groups, partially offset by an allowance for expected credit losses on the Company’s held-to-maturity debt security.

The prior year period amount is primarily attributable to a gain on the sale of corporate-owned clubs and a gain on insurance proceeds, partially offset by an allowance for expected credit losses on the Company’s held-to-maturity debt security and costs incurred on the closure of the Company’s Florida Corporate Support Center located in Orlando, Florida.

Based on our current level of operations, we believe that with our available cash balance, the cash generated from our operations, and amounts available under our 2022 Variable Funding Notes will be adequate to meet our anticipated debt service requirements and obligations under our tax benefit arrangements, capital expenditures and working capital needs for at least the next 12 months.

There can be no assurance that our business will generate sufficient cash flows from operations or otherwise to enable us to service our indebtedness, including our securitized senior notes, or to make anticipated capital expenditures.

Our future operating performance and our ability to service, extend or refinance our indebtedness will be subject to future economic conditions and to financial, business and other factors, many of which are beyond our control.
